item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Will discuss proposing 'Special Election Act'... Early voting must be eliminated" (장동혁 “‘재선거 특별법’ 발의 논의하겠다…사전투표 없애야”)
item.description:
People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk stated on the 9th regarding the shortage of ballot papers that occurred during the 6·3 local elections, "We will promptly initiate internal party discussions to propose a special act for conducting a re-election." He also argued, "We must expedite the revision of the election law so that re-elections can be conducted without early voting." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 9일 6·3 지방선거에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 “재선거 실시를 위한 특별법을 발의할 수 있도록 신속하게 당내 논의를 진행하겠다”고 했다. 아울러 “재선거부터 사전투표 없이 실시할 수 있도록 선거법 개정 작업을 서둘러야 한다”고 주장했다.)

Holding a press conference at the National Assembly that morning, Director Jang said, "The fundamental solution to this disenfranchisement incident is ultimately a nationwide re-election. Even what has been revealed so far constitutes sufficient grounds for a re-election." (장 대표는 이날 오전 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “이번 참정권 박탈 사태를 근본적으로 해결하는 것은 결국 전국 재선거밖에 없다”며 “지금 드러난 것만 하더라도 충분히 재선거 사유가 된다”고 말했다.)

Director Jang continued, "We will promptly hold internal discussions to propose a special act for conducting a re-election," and emphasized, "We must extend the main voting date and absolutely eliminate early voting. The revision of the election law should be expedited so that re-elections can be conducted without early voting." Director Jang also said, "Let's meet with Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae even today and start discussions on pursuing a special counsel law. Only if we entrust this to a special counsel recommended by the People Power Party can the public trust the results." (장 대표는 이어 “재선거 실시를 위한 특별법을 발의할 수 있도록 신속하게 당내 논의를 진행하겠다”며 “본투표 날짜를 늘리고 사전투표는 반드시 없애야 한다. 재선거부터 사전투표 없이 실시할 수 있도록 선거법 개정 작업을 서둘러야 할 것”이라고 강조했다. 장 대표는 또 “정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 오늘이라도 당장 만나서 특검법 추진부터 논의하자”라며 “국민의힘이 추천하는 특검에게 맡겨야 국민도 그 결과를 신뢰할 수 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the criticism that the re-election is interpreted as a demand for the resignation of Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, he refuted, "Our position is that local elections virtually need to be held again nationwide. It is inappropriate to mention only one specific candidate and ask if this is pressure for that candidate's resignation when we are talking about principles." (재선거가 오세훈 서울시장 사퇴 요구로 해석된다는 지적엔 “전국에 걸쳐서 지선을 사실상 다시 실시해야 한단 입장”이라며 “원칙을 이야기하는 데 특정 후보 1명만을 거론하면서 특정 후보에 대한 사퇴 압박이냐고 묻는 것은 온당치 않다”고 반박했다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr 김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Ballot shortage also anticipated in Gangnam"… Election Commission says "Contact us when 500 remain" instead of replenishing (강남서도 “투표지 부족 예상”…선관위, 보충 대신 “500매 남으면 연락하라”)
item.description:
On election day, not only in Songpa-gu, Seoul, but also in Gangnam-gu, concerns about a ballot shortage were reportedly conveyed to the Election Commission from the morning, but the Commission did not take immediate replenishment measures. (선거 당일 서울 송파구뿐 아니라 강남구에서도 오전부터 투표용지 부족 우려가 선거관리위원회에 전달됐지만, 선관위가 즉각적인 보충 조처에 나서지 않은 것으로 나타났다.)

According to a summary from a Gangnam-gu official on the 9th, at around 11:33 a.m. on the 3rd, the day of the local elections, a report was sent to the Gangnam-gu Election Commission from the 4th polling station in Cheongdam-dong, Gangnam-gu, stating, "It seems ballots will be insufficient." However, it was confirmed that the Gangnam-gu Election Commission instructed them to "contact us again when about 500 ballots remain." (9일 강남구 관계자 설명을 종합하면, 지방선거 본투표일인 지난 3일 오전 11시33분께 강남구 청담동 제4투표소에서 “투표용지가 부족할 것 같다”는 취지의 보고가 강남구 선관위에 전달됐다. 그러나 강남구 선관위는 “500매 정도 남았을 때 다시 연락해달라”고 안내한 것으로 파악됐다.)

A Gangnam-gu official said, "I understand that around 11:33 a.m., although ballots were still remaining, they reported that they might be insufficient," adding, "I heard that the Election Commission, likely having its own standards, asked them to contact again when about 500 ballots were left." (강남구 관계자는 “오전 11시33분 정도에 투표용지가 아직 남아 있기는 했지만 부족할 것 같다고 보고한 것으로 안다”며 “선관위에서도 기준 같은 게 있으니 500매 정도 됐을 때 다시 연락을 달라고 한 것으로 들었다”고 말했다.)

Earlier, in Songpa-gu, Seoul, concerns about a ballot shortage were raised around 11 a.m. on the same day, but after the Election Commission told them to "wait until 100 ballots remain," the ballots were actually exhausted, leading to complaints from voters. This means that different replenishment standards—'100' in Songpa-gu and '500' in Gangnam-gu—were applied, raising criticism that the on-site response criteria were unclear. (앞서 서울 송파구에서도 같은 날 오전 11시께 투표용지 부족 우려가 제기됐지만, 선관위가 “100매가 남을 때까지 기다리라”고 한 뒤 실제 용지가 소진돼 유권자들이 항의하는 일이 벌어졌다. 송파구와 강남구에서 각각 ‘100매’와 ‘500매’라는 서로 다른 추가 공급 기준이 적용된 셈이어서, 현장 대응 기준이 명확하지 않았다는 지적이 나온다.)

It was also reported that voting at the relevant polling station in Gangnam-gu ended past the 6 p.m. closing time. A Gangnam-gu official said, "There were a few people with waiting tickets," adding, "It wasn't many, but they finished voting around 6:10 p.m." (강남구의 해당 투표소도 투표 마감 시각인 오후 6시를 넘겨 투표가 끝난 것으로 전해졌다. 강남구 관계자는 “대기표를 받은 분들이 조금 있었다”며 “많지는 않았지만 그분들이 투표를 하느라 오후 6시10분께 끝났다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the ballot shortage incident, the Election Commission has stated that it will investigate the situation through a fact-finding committee. It is also known that the police are reviewing messenger conversations among election officials in areas that experienced ballot shortages and the details of ballot supply. (선관위는 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 진상규명위원회를 통해 당시 상황을 조사하겠다는 입장이다. 경찰도 당시 투표용지가 부족했던 지역의 선거 담당자들이 나눈 메신저 대화와 투표용지 공급 경위 등을 들여다보고 있는 것으로 알려졌다.)

Reporter Shin Hyung-chul newiron@hani.co.kr (신형철 기자 newiron@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Jun-seok: "Jang Dong-hyuk's People Power Party Has Merged with Hwang Kyo-ahn's Party... It Has Become the 'Yoon Again' Party" (이준석 “장동혁의 국힘, 황교안당과 일체화…윤어게인 정당 돼”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, criticized People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk on the 9th for his push to abolish early voting, stating, "As of today, the People Power Party has become the 'Yoon Again' Party." (이준석 개혁신당 대표가 9일 장동혁 국민의힘 대표의 사전투표제 폐지 주장에 대해 “오늘부로 국민의힘은 윤어게인 정당이 됐다”고 비판했다.)

Posting on his Facebook page that day, he said, "The People Power Party has effectively declared a merger with the Liberty and Innovation Party of former Prime Minister Hwang Kyo-ahn, which is a single-issue party fixated on election fraud, and has also declared unification with former President Yoon Seok-youl, who sent the military to the National Election Commission in a state of delusion." He added, "Thirsty leader Jang Dong-hyuk has taken a refreshing gulp of seawater, and now he will have no choice but to keep drinking to quench his thirst." (그는 이날 자신의 페이스북에 글을 올려 “국민의힘은 사실상 부정선거 단일의제 정당인 황교안 전 총리의 자유와혁신과 일체화를 선언하고, 망상에 빠져 선관위로 군대를 보낸 윤석열 전 대통령과의 일체화를 선언한 것”이라며 “목마른 장동혁 대표가 시원하게 들이킨 바닷물 한 컵, 이제 갈증을 해소하기 위해 계속 들이킬 수 밖에 없을 것”이라고 말했다.)

Earlier that day, Jang held a press conference at the National Assembly regarding the shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections, announcing his intention to pursue a "special law for holding by-elections" while stating, "We should revise the election law to abolish early voting starting from by-elections." (앞서, 장 대표는 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 6·3 지방선거에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 ‘재선거 실시 특별법’ 추진 뜻을 밝히면서 “재선거부터 사전투표를 폐지하도록 선거법을 개정해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Regarding this, Lee pointed out, "Early voting was introduced as a replacement for absentee voting, which had a cumbersome reporting process, and it is the last safeguard to protect the vote of the younger generation, who cannot easily relocate due to short-term work or studies." He added, "It is a case of the pot calling the kettle black to condemn a situation where citizens were unable to cast their votes due to a shortage of ballot papers, while proposing a solution that blocks the very path for citizens to exercise their vote." He further challenged Jang, saying, "If you really want to abolish it, boldly propose a bill and hold a public hearing to prove that the conspiracy theory that early voting is a channel for election fraud is false, and demonstrate that the People Power Party is not a party swayed by such conspiracy theories." (이 대표는 이를 두고 “사전투표는 신고 절차가 번거롭던 부재자투표를 대신해 도입된 제도로, 단기 근무와 학업 때문에 주소지를 쉽게 옮기지 못하는 젊은 세대에게는 한 표를 지켜주는 마지막 장치”라며 “투표용지가 부족해 국민이 한 표를 행사하지 못한 사태를 규탄하면서, 그 해법으로 국민이 한 표를 행사할 길을 막겠다고 하는 건 적반하장”이라고 지적했다. 이어 장 대표를 향해 “정 폐지하고 싶다면 당당하게 법안을 발의하고 공청회를 열어 사전투표가 부정선거의 통로라는 음모론이 아니라는 걸, 국민의힘이 음모론에 휘둘리는 정당이 아님을 입증하라”고 했다.)

Lee Ji-eun, Reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kwon Young-se: "We need to discuss Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation... Nationwide re-election is inappropriate" (권영세 “장동혁 대표 사퇴 논의해야…전면적 재선거는 부적절”)
item.description:
Kwon Young-se, a five-term lawmaker of the People Power Party (PPP), stated that there is a need to discuss the resignation of PPP Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk. (국민의힘 5선 중진인 권영세 의원이 장동혁 국민의힘 대표의 사퇴에 대해 논의할 필요가 있다고 밝혔다.)

Appearing on SBS Radio's "Kim Tae-hyun's Political Show" on the 9th, Kwon said, "This election is one we lost," adding, "We need to continuously discuss what measures are necessary for our party to avoid losing further, including whether the leadership might step down, not necessarily immediately, but as part of the discussions." He emphasized, "It's not about whether the leadership resigns right away, but we need to keep talking about what actions, including leadership stepping down, are needed." <<> When asked by the host, "Does Chairman Jang have to resign?" Kwon replied, "That should be included in the discussions." <<> Regarding the results of the June 3 local elections, Kwon stressed, "Objectively, (the PPP) lost." He said, "Of course, Oh Se-hoon, our candidate, won (the Seoul mayoral election) under our party's banner, but it was the difference in ability and character between Oh Se-hoon and (Democratic Party candidate) Jung Won-oh that was decisive. There was absolutely nothing about our party's strategy or preparation that was good." <<> Kwon noted that after the 2011 Seoul mayoral by-election defeat, "Lawmakers Yoo Seong-min and Nam Kyung-pil, who were supreme council members, stepped down, and that system collapsed." He added, "Even though (the PPP) essentially lost this election, the quietness about it needs to change." <<> Regarding Chairman Jang's push for a "nationwide re-election including Seoul," Kwon emphasized that it is "not appropriate to immediately present a full-scale re-election as the primary goal" and that an investigation should come first. On the investigation, Kwon added, "Through a special counsel recommended by the opposition party, objective investigative procedures should help in uncovering the truth." <<> Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (권 의원은 9일 에스비에스(SBS) 라디오 ‘김태현의 정치쇼’에 출연해 “이번 선거는 우리가 진 선거다”라며 이같이 말했다. 권 의원은 “우리 당이 앞으로 더 이상 지지 않기 위해 어떤 조치들이 필요한지에 대해 당장 지도부의 사퇴 이런 건 아니더라도 어떤 조치들이 필요할지 지도부 사퇴까지 포함해서 계속해서 논의를 해나갈 필요가 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee's European Tour Send-off: "Kim Min-seok Comes, Jeong Cheong-rae Skips" – Prelude to August Party Convention? (‘김민석 오고 정청래 빠진’ 이 대통령 순방 배웅…8월 전당대회 전초전?)
item.description:
As President Lee Jae-myung departed for a European tour on the 9th to attend the Group of Seven (G7) summit and other events, the absence of senior leadership from the Democratic Party of Korea, including Party Leader Jeong Cheong-rae, during the send-off has drawn attention to the circumstances. <<> President Lee departed around 9 a.m. from Seoul Air Base in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, aboard the presidential jet for Brussels, Belgium. While several officials from the presidential office and government attended the farewell ceremony, the Democratic Party leadership was absent. During the state visits to India and Vietnam in April, Party Leader Jeong and Floor Leader Han Byeong-do had been present at the airport for the send-off. <<> In contrast, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok personally came to the airport to see off President Lee. This is considered an unusual move, given that typically the presidential chief of staff attends departure events, while the prime minister attends return events. Party Leader Jeong and Prime Minister Kim are highly likely to face off at the Democratic Party convention scheduled for August 17. <<> At a press conference marking his first year in office held the previous day at the State Guest House, President Lee remarked, "The opposition must wield its spear well, but the ruling party must serve as a vessel," and "A party that excels in insults does not become a strong party." These pointed comments have been interpreted as an indirect critique of the ruling party's leadership. Regarding Prime Minister Kim, President Lee praised him, saying, "With truly outstanding leadership, the cabinet has run fiercely toward a single goal, following the direction I set, with minimal noise. I wonder if there has ever been a cabinet that achieved so many concrete results in such a short period." <<> Regarding the ruling party leadership's absence from the send-off, the presidential office explained, "Considering the prolonged Middle East war and the need to address the mismanagement of the National Election Commission, we minimized the number of attendees, including officials from the presidential office and cabinet." <<> By Sim Woo-sam, Reporter wu32@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 9일 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 참석 등을 위해 유럽 순방길에 오른 가운데 정청래 더불어민주당 대표 등 당 지도부가 배웅을 나오지 않아 배경에 관심이 쏠리고 있다.)

item.title: China's 'Resist America, Aid Korea' Phrase Appears on Korean War Educational Poster… War Memorial Removes It Amid Controversy (6·25 교육 포스터에 중국 시각 ‘항미원조’ 표현…전쟁기념관, 논란 되자 삭제)
item.description:
A controversy has arisen after the War Memorial of Korea, located in Yongsan, Seoul and operated by the Korea War Memorial Foundation, used China's term 'Resist America, Aid Korea' in promotional materials for an educational program interpreting the Korean War. (서울 용산 전쟁기념관을 운영하는 전쟁기념사업회가 준비하는 한국전쟁 해설 교육 프로그램 홍보에 중국이 사용하는 ‘항미원조’ 표현이 들어가 논란이 일고 있다.)

Starting last month on the 30th, the Foundation posted a notice on its website inviting participants for an educational event titled 'The Korean War, Different Interpretations' (Two Perspectives Gazing at the Yalu River), held in commemoration of the Patriots and Veterans Day. (전쟁기념사업회는 지난달 30일부터 누리집을 통해 호국보훈의 날 기념으로 ‘6·25 전쟁, 서로 다른 해석’(압록강을 바라보는 두 시선)이라는 주제의 교육을 진행한다고 공지하고 참가 신청을 받고 있다.)

The target audience ranges from fourth-grade elementary students to adults. The sessions, each lasting 50 minutes, will be conducted by instructors from the Foundation's commentary team in the museum's exhibition halls on the morning of the 13th and the afternoon of the 25th. (초등학교 4학년 이상부터 성인이 교육 대상이다. 전쟁기념사업회 해설팀 강사가 교육하며 오는 13일 오전과 25일 오후 각각 50분씩 전쟁기념관 전시실에서 진행된다.)

In the program overview, the Foundation explained, 'By comparing the perspectives of South Korea and China on the Korean War, participants can understand the war from diverse viewpoints.' The promotional poster features two boys, presumably representing South Korean and Chinese nationalities. Above the South Korean boy are the Taegeukgi and the phrase '6·25 War,' while above the Chinese boy are the phrase 'Resist America, Aid Korea' and the Chinese flag. China refers to the Korean War as the 'War to Resist America and Aid Korea,' viewing it as a conflict where they fought against imperialist America to assist Joseon (North Korea). (사업회는 해설 개요를 통해 “6·25 전쟁을 바라보는 한국과 중국의 시각을 비교하면서 6·25 전쟁을 다양한 시각에서 이해할 수 있다”고 설명했다. 행사 안내 포스터에는 한국과 중국 국적으로 보이는 두 소년이 서 있는 모습이 담겼다. 한국 소년 위에는 태극기와 6·25전쟁, 중국 소년 위에는 항미원조와 중국 국기가 그려져 있다. 중국은 한국전쟁을 항미원조전쟁으로 부르고 자신들이 제국주의 미국과 맞서 싸우며 조선(북한)을 도운 전쟁으로 본다.)

Once the poster and the educational notice were released, criticism emerged questioning whether it was appropriate to educate South Koreans, including elementary school students, using China's perspective of 'Resist America, Aid Korea.' Amid the controversy, the Foundation removed the poster around 10 a.m. on the same day. (교육 공지가 포스터와 함께 나가자 이런 항미원조란 중국 쪽 시각을 초등학생을 포함한 한국인에게 교육하는게 맞느냐는 지적이 나왔다. 논란이 되자 기념사업회는 이날 오전 10시쯤 해당 포스터를 삭제했다.)

In response, a representative from the Korea War Memorial Foundation explained, 'This educational program aims to correct China's erroneous claims based on historical facts.' (이에 대해 전쟁기념사업회 관계자는 “해당 교육은 역사적 사실에 기반해 중국의 잘못된 주장을 바로잡는 내용”이라고 해명했다.)

The Korean War is referred to by various names domestically and internationally. Typically, war names are determined after the conflict ends, based on the victors or agreements among the parties involved. In cases like the Korean War, which ended in an armistice without a clear victor, differing names emerge as each party seeks to remember the war in its own way. (국내외에서 한국전쟁은 다양한 이름으로 불린다. 대개 전쟁 이름은 전쟁이 끝난 뒤 전쟁에서 이긴 나라 또는 전쟁 당사자들 간의 합의에 따라 확정된다. 한국전쟁처럼 승자 없이 휴전된 경우, 각자 방식대로 전쟁을 기억하려는 당사자들이 주장하는 다양한 이름들이 등장한다.)

In South Korea, it is called the 'June 25 Incident,' 'June 25 Disturbance,' 'Korean Disturbance,' 'June 25 War,' and 'Korean War.' The official term used by the government is the 'June 25 War,' emphasizing that the war began on June 25, 1950, with a surprise attack by North Korea, focusing on the initiator and responsibility for the outbreak. (국내에서는 6·25사변, 6·25동란, 한국동란, 6·25전쟁, 한국전쟁 등으로 부른다. 정부가 사용하는 공식 용어는 ‘6·25전쟁’이다. 1950년 6월25일 북한의 기습공격으로 한국전쟁이 발발됐다는 사실을 강조한다. 공격 주체, 전쟁 개시 책임에 초점이 맞춰졌다.)

North Korea calls it the 'Fatherland Liberation War.' It designates July 27, 1953, the date of the armistice agreement, as 'Victory Day,' celebrating the 'victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.' North Korea downplays its responsibility for starting the war and instead highlights July 27 as a triumph over the United States. China marks October 25 as the anniversary of 'Resist America, Aid Korea,' which commemorates the day in 1950 when the Chinese People's Volunteer Army crossed the Yalu River and first engaged South Korean forces at Onjeong-ri in Unsan County, North Pyongan Province. Although China claims the Korean War was fundamentally a war where they fought against the United States, many major battles at the regiment level and above during the three-year war took place between South Korean and Chinese forces. (북한은 ‘조국해방전쟁’이라고 한다. 북한은 한국전쟁 정전협정이 체결된 1953년 7월27일을 ‘조국해방전쟁 승리’를 기념하는 ‘전승절’이라 부른다. 북한은 전쟁 개시 책임은 눈감고 미국과의 전쟁에서 승리했다며 7월27일을 강조해 왔다. 중국이 항미원조 기념일로 삼는 10월25일은 1950년 압록강을 넘어온 중국인민지원군이 평안북도 운산군 온정리에서 국군과 처음으로 교전한 날이다. 중국은 한국전쟁의 기본 성격을 자신들이 미국과 맞서 싸운 전쟁으로 주장하지만, 한국전쟁 3년간 연대급 이상 주요 전투들은 상당수가 국군과 중국군 사이에서 벌어졌다.)

In Japan, it is called the 'Joseon War' (Korean War), while in the United States and Europe, it is known as the 'Korean War,' 'Korean Conflict,' 'Korean Civil War,' 'limited war' (in the U.S.), and 'forgotten war' (also in the U.S.), among others. (일본에서는 조선전쟁(朝鮮戰爭), 미국과 유럽에서는 Korean War, Korean Conflict, Korean Civil War, 제한전쟁(limited war, 미국), 잊힌 전쟁(forgotten war, 미국) 등으로 불린다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim Min-seok: "The Ballot Shortage... We Must Take Young People's Concerns Seriously" (김민석 총리 “투표지 부족사태…청년들 문제의식 무겁게 받아들여야”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 9th, "The right to vote is the foundation of democracy," adding, "The National Assembly, political circles, and relevant agencies should take the concerns of young people seriously." (김민석 국무총리가 9일 “참정권은 민주주의의 근간”이라며 “국회와 정치권, 관계기관이 청년들의 문제의식을 무겁게 받아들일 것”이라고 말했다.)

In his opening remarks at a meeting of ministers on youth policy held at the Seoul Government Complex, Prime Minister Kim said, "I hope the entire government remains vigilant and responds to this issue (the ballot shortage)." ( 김 총리는 이날 정부서울청사에서 열린 청년정책 관계장관회의 모두발언에서 “정부 모두가 그 문제(투표지 부족사태)에 대해 경각심을 갖고 대처했으면 한다”며 이렇게 말했다. )

Referring to a meeting held on the 7th at the Seoul Government Complex with former and current student council presidents regarding the local elections, Prime Minister Kim said, "Right here, a few days ago, we held a meeting with college student representatives who had protested and expressed concerns about the ballot shortage. I felt ashamed. It was regrettable that we failed to think more sensitively, respond faster, and find solutions to such issues, and it has made me feel a greater sense of responsibility." ( 김 총리는 지난 7일 정부서울청사에서 개최한 ‘지방선거 관련 전·현직 총학생회 대표 간담회’를 언급하며 “바로 이 자리에서 며칠 전에 이번 투표지 부족문제와 관련해서 시위하고 또 걱정하는 대학생 대표들을 모시고 간담회를 했다. 부끄러웠다. 그런 문제에 대해서 저희가 더 민감하게 생각하고 더 빨리 대처해 해결책을 만들어내야 하는데 그러지 못한 상황이 안타까웠고 책임감을 더 가지게 됐다”고 말했다. )

Regarding the meeting's agenda items, such as improving systems to be family-friendly and measures for corporate support and job-linked assistance, Prime Minister Kim said, "We must explore various ways to overcome the situation where young people, when starting a family, face disadvantages in housing, finance, and taxation instead of receiving blessings." ( 김 총리는 이어 결혼친화형 제도개선, 기업지원·일자리연계형 지원 방안 등 회의 안건을 두고 “청년들이 가정을 꾸리면 축복이 아니라 오히려 주거·금융·세제에서 불이익을 받는 이 상황을 타개하기 위한 여러 방안을 모색해야 한다”고 했다. )

He also stated, "In a situation where youth unemployment and the recruitment difficulties of small and medium-sized enterprises coexist, strengthening incentives for companies that create jobs is very timely and important. Linking recruitment of young people to areas vulnerable to AI (Artificial Intelligence) transformation is also significant in terms of alleviating polarization between industries." ( 또한 “청년 취업난과 중소기업 구직난이 공존하는 상황에서 일자리를 창출하는 기업에 인센티브를 강화하는 방안은 매우 시의적절하고 중요하다”며 “에이아이(AI·인공지능) 전환 취약 부분에 청년 채용을 연계하는 것은 산업 간 양극화 완화 차원에서도 의미가 크다”고 했다. )

Additionally, Prime Minister Kim said, "Although young people who get injured or fall ill during their military service receive free treatment at military hospitals, sometimes they suffer aftereffects after discharge. It is necessary to expand injury insurance related to military service." ( 김 총리는 아울러 “청년들이 군대에서 다치거나 아픈 경우 군 병원에서 무료로 치료를 받기는 하는데, 제대 후에 후유증이 남는 경우도 있다”며 “군 복무 관련 상해보험을 확대할 필요가 있다”고 했다. )

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr ( 고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party: "Special Counsel for Manipulated Indictments and Supplementary Investigation Powers of Prosecutors to Be Discussed After Assembly Formation" (민주 “조작기소 특검·검찰 보완수사권, 원 구성 이후 논의”)
item.description:
With the June 3 local elections concluded, attention in the Democratic Party is turning to the "Special Counsel Act on Manipulated Indictments," which was postponed after the elections, and the "Criminal Procedure Act Amendment," a follow-up measure to prosecutorial reform. The Democratic Party plans to first focus on a parliamentary investigation into the shortage of ballots for the local elections. Once the Judiciary Committee is formed in the latter half of the 22nd National Assembly, discussions on handling these bills are expected to commence. (6·3 지방선거가 끝나면서 더불어민주당이 선거 뒤로 미뤄 둔 ‘조작기소 특검법’과 검찰개혁 후속 조처인 ‘형사소송법 개정’ 처리에 관심이 쏠린다. 민주당은 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 국정조사에 먼저 집중하고, 22대 국회 후반기 법제사법위원회가 꾸려지면 해당 법안 처리 논의에 착수할 전망이다.)

A senior official from the Democratic Party's floor leadership said in a phone call with *The Hankyoreh* on the 9th, "Right after the local elections and given the urgent need for a parliamentary probe of the election commission, neither the Special Counsel Act on Manipulated Indictments nor the Criminal Procedure Act amendment has been discussed yet. Discussions involving the party, government, and presidential office are expected to begin around June when the Assembly forms its committees, centered on the Judiciary Committee." A multi-term Democratic Party lawmaker conveyed the internal sentiment, saying, "Even before the committee formation, if necessary, we could discuss it not just in standing committees but also at a general meeting of lawmakers. But it seems unlikely we will immediately discuss the Special Counsel Act or the Criminal Procedure Act amendment." The Democratic Party insists that the formation of 22nd National Assembly committees for the latter half must be completed by the 18th. However, if negotiations with the People Power Party drag on, the committee formation could slip into July. (민주당 원내 지도부 관계자는 9일 한겨레와의 통화에서 “지방선거 직후인 데다가 선관위 국정조사가 시급한 상황이라 조작기소 특검법이나 형사소송법 개정 모두 논의가 이뤄지지 않았다”라며 “6월 원 구성 이후 법제사법위원회 중심으로 당·정·청 협의 등이 이뤄질 것으로 보인다”라고 했다. 민주당 한 다선 의원은 “원 구성 이전이라도 필요하다면 상임위가 아니라 의원총회에서도 논의하겠지만 당장 조작기소 특검법이나 형사소송법 개정 논의를 할 것 같지는 않다”고 당내 기류를 전했다. 민주당은 22대 국회 후반기 원 구성을 오는 18일까지 마쳐야 한다는 입장인데, 국민의힘과 협상이 길어질 경우 원 구성은 7월로 넘어갈 수 있다.)

Within the party, President Yoon's remarks at his first-year anniversary press conference the previous day—where he said, "If there are any wrongful (prosecutorial) indictments, we can correct them; if there are none, we can leave them as is"—are seen as making the re-pursuit of the Special Counsel Act on Manipulated Indictments a predetermined course. A senior lawmaker said, "President Yoon is convinced that the prosecution's (alleged) manipulated indictments are certain, and that wrongful indictments must naturally be withdrawn." However, internal party discussions on granting the authority to withdraw indictments, as included in the special counsel bill, are expected to take place later. Democratic Party Secretary General Cho Seung-rae stated at a press briefing the previous day regarding the special counsel bill, "We are considering everything, including the content and timing, with an open mind." (당내에서는 이 대통령이 전날 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 “(검찰의 기소가) 잘못된 게 있으면 바로 잡으면 되는 거고 잘못된 게 없으면 놔두면 되는 것”이라고 공개 발언한 만큼 조작기소 특검법 재추진은 정해진 수순으로 보고 있다. 한 중진 의원은 “이 대통령은 (검찰이) 조작기소한 것이 확실하고 잘못된 기소는 당연히 취소해야 된다는 확신을 갖고 있다”고 했다. 다만 특검법안에 포함된 공소취소 권한 부여에 대한 당내 논의는 추후 이뤄질 것으로 예상된다. 조승래 민주당 사무총장은 전날 기자간담회에서 특검법과 관련해 “내용과 시기 등을 다 열어놓고 고민 중”이라고 밝혔다.)

Discussions on the Criminal Procedure Act amendment, which will determine whether to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, are also expected to accelerate after the committee formation. The Prosecutorial Reform Task Force under the Prime Minister's Office aims to prepare multiple versions of the amendment addressing the existence of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers as early as this week. Subsequent consultations between the party and government are anticipated. (검찰의 보완수사권 폐지 여부를 결정할 형사소송법 개정안 논의도 원 구성 이후 속도를 낼 것으로 예상된다. 총리실 산하 검찰개혁추진단은 이르면 이번 주 안에 검찰의 보완수사권 유무를 담은 형사소송법 개정안 복수안을 마련하는 것을 목표로 하고 있다. 이후 당정 협의가 이뤄질 것으로 보인다.)

The previous day, President Yoon said at a press conference regarding whether to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, "I hope it will be handed over to the National Assembly for discussion, and the government will not insist on any particular position." President Yoon had previously maintained that the prosecution should retain supplementary investigation powers for exceptional cases, but his remarks that day are interpreted as a retreat from his earlier stance. A government official said, "After the government prepares multiple versions of the Criminal Procedure Act amendment and hands them over to the ruling party, there may be various ways to proceed with discussions thereafter. The president's remarks yesterday appear to indicate respect for the ruling party's opinion." (전날 이 대통령은 기자회견에서 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 여부에 대해 “국회로 넘겨 논의하고 정부 입장을 어느 쪽으로 고집하지 말면 좋겠다”고 한 바 있다. 이 대통령은 그간 예외적인 사안에 대해 검찰에 보완수사권을 부여해야 한다는 입장이었으나 이날 발언은 기존 입장에서 물러선 것으로 해석된다. 정부 관계자는 “정부가 형사소송법 개정안 복수안을 마련해 여당에 넘긴 뒤 그 이후에는 어떻게 논의할지 다양한 방식이 있을 텐데, 어제 대통령의 말은 여당 의견을 존중하겠다는 것으로 보인다”라고 말했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Fans Conspiracy Theories by Claiming "Identical Vote Tallies at Two Advance Polling Stations" – Election Commission Refutes (장동혁 “사전투표 2곳 득표수 동일” 음모론에 장작 넣기…선관위 반박)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, raised an issue by claiming that in the advance voting results for the Incheon Mayor and the Gwangju-Jeonnam Integrated Special City Mayor elections, identical vote counts for candidates emerged in different regions, which the respective local election commissions refuted as a "coincidence." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 인천광역시장과 광주전남통합특별시장 선거 관내 사전투표 결과, 지역이 다른데 후보별 득표수가 같은 사례가 발생했다며 문제 삼자 해당 지역 선거관리위원회는 “우연의 일치”라며 반박했다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly on the 9th, Representative Jang stated, "In the advance voting for Songdo 1 and 2 neighborhoods in the Incheon mayoral election, the votes for People Power Party's Yoo Jeong-bok and Democratic Party's Park Chan-dae were completely identical, with a probability of 1 in 590 million," and "In the Gwangju-Jeonnam integrated mayoral election, there were as many as 10 regions where the vote counts for the two candidates were the same, meaning the probability of 1 in 590 million would need to be multiplied six times." (장 대표는 9일 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “인천시장 선거 송도 1·2동 관내 사전투표에서 국민의힘 유정복, 민주당 박찬대 후보 득표수가 완전히 일치했는데 그 확률이 5억9천만분의 1”이라며 “광주·전남 통합시장 선거에서는 두 후보의 투표수가 똑같은 지역이 무려 10곳이나 있었는데 그렇다면 확률적으로 5억9천만분의 1을 6번 곱해야 하는 것”이라고 주장했다.)

Representative Jang brought up this issue alongside the shortage of ballot papers, calling it "an even more unbelievable situation." He then called for nationwide re-elections and the introduction of a special counsel. (장 대표는 투표용지 부족 사태와 함께 이를 거론하며 “더 믿기 어려운 일”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 전국 단위의 재선거 실시와 함께 특검 도입을 촉구했다.)

The Incheon Metropolitan City Election Commission and the Jeonnam Election Commission each released statements on the same day, immediately refuting Representative Jang's claims. (인천광역시선거관리위원회와 전남선거관리위원회는 이날 각각 자료를 내어 장 대표의 주장을 즉각 반박했다.)

The Incheon Election Commission confirmed that, as Representative Jang stated, the advance voting results for Songdo 1 and Songdo 2 neighborhoods showed Democratic Party candidate Park Chan-dae receiving 3,030 votes in both locations, and People Power Party candidate Yoo Jeong-bok receiving 1,440 votes in both. However, the total number of voters differed between the two locations—4,548 and 4,540, respectively. The vote counts for Reform Party candidate Lee Gi-bung also differed between the two locations, with 61 and 47 votes. Invalid votes were 15 and 22, and abstentions were 2 and 1, also showing differences. (인천선관위는 장 대표 말대로 송도1동 사전투표와 송도2동 사전투표 결과 박찬대 더불어민주당 후보가 두 곳에서 모두 각각 3030표를 득표했고, 유정복 국민의힘 후보가 모두 1440표를 득표했다고 밝혔다. 그런데 전체 선거인 수는 두 곳이 각각 4548명과 4540명으로 차이가 있었다. 박 후보와 유 후보 외에 개혁신당 이기붕 후보의 득표수는 두 곳에서 각각 61표와 47표로 달랐다. 무효표는 15표와 22표, 기권은 2표와 1표로 역시 차이가 있었다.)

The Incheon Election Commission stated, "While it may be claimed that the identical advance voting results from Songdo 1 and Songdo 2 are manipulated, the detailed breakdown shows that the total number of voters and the remaining votes are all different," explaining that the matching figures were a "coincidental outcome." (인천선관위는 “송도1동과 송도2동의 관내 사전투표 결과가 일치해 조작된 것처럼 주장하지만, 상세 내역을 보면 전체 투표자 수와 나머지 표수는 모두 다르다”며 수치가 같은 부분은 “우연한 결과”라고 밝혔다.)

The explanation from the Jeonnam Election Commission was also that it was a "coincidental outcome." (전남선관위의 설명도 “우연한 결과”라는 것이었다.)

In Jeonnam's Geumsan-myeon, Democratic Party candidate Min Hyeong-bae received 1,401 votes, and People Power Party candidate Lee Jeong-hyeon received 120 votes, while in Gwangju's Gwangsan-gu Songjeong 1-dong, the counts were also identical at 1,401 and 120 votes. However, the total number of voters in the two locations differed—1,828 and 1,764—and vote counts for other candidates also varied. The same was true for other regions Representative Jang highlighted. (전남군 금산면에서 민형배 민주당 후보가 1401표, 이정현 국민의힘 후보가 120표를 었었고, 광주 광산구 송정1동에서도 각각 1401표와 120표로 수치가 같았다. 하지만 두 곳의 전체 선거인 수는 1828명과 1764명으로 달랐고, 두 후보를 제외한 나머지 후보들의 득표수도 모두 달랐다. 장 대표가 지적한 다른 지역의 결과도 마찬가지였다.)

The Jeonnam Election Commission added, "After the advance voting ended, the ballot boxes were sealed and locked under the observation of vote observers, escorted by vote observers and police to each district, city, or county election commission, and stored securely in locations with CCTV until election day. Then, after the voting closed on election day, they were transported to each counting station, where counting proceeded independently under the observation of party-recommended commissioners and counting observers," and "It is simply a coincidence that results tallied by different people in different locations matched by chance." (전남선관위는 “사전투표함은 사전투표 종료 뒤 투표참관인의 참관 아래 봉쇄·봉인되었으며, 투표참관인과 호송 경찰 등이 동반해 각 구·시·군선거관리위원회로 이송한 후 선거일까지 시시티브이(CCTV)가 설치된 장소에 안전하게 보관됐다. 이후 선거일 투표 마감 시각 후 정당 추천위원과 개표 참관인이 참관하는 가운데 각 개표소로 이송되어 독립적으로 개표가 진행됐다”며 “서로 다른 장소에서 서로 다른 사람들이 집계한 결과가 우연히 맞아떨어진 것뿐”이라고 덧붙였다.)

The Election Commission attached original vote-counting tables for each region and emphasized, "We urge refraining from raising and spreading baseless suspicions about voting results that were fairly tallied by different equipment and personnel, solely on the grounds of statistical improbability." (선관위는 지역별 개표 상황표 원본을 첨부하며 “확률적으로 희박하다는 이유만으로, 각기 다른 장비와 인력을 통해 공정하게 집계된 투표 결과에 대해 근거 없는 의혹을 제기하고 확산하는 행위를 자제해 주시기를 당부드린다”고 강조했다.)

Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ruling and Opposition Agree on National Assembly Investigation into Election Commission… But Differ on Police Dissolution Probe and Special Committee Formation (‘선관위 국정조사’ 여야 공감에도…경찰 해산 조사, 국조특위 구성엔 이견)
item.description:
The ruling and opposition parties have formed a consensus on pushing for a National Assembly investigation into the "June 3 local elections ballot shortage crisis," but they hold differing views on the scope of the probe and the formation of a special committee. (여야가 ‘6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태’에 대한 국회 국정조사 추진에 공감대를 형성했으나 조사 범위와 특별위원회 구성을 두고 이견을 보이고 있다.)

National Assembly Floor Leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, Han Byung-do, said at a party meeting on the 9th, "This incident is a disaster that has fatally undermined both South Korea's democracy and the right to vote," adding, "We will convene an immediate plenary session this week to report on the investigation plan. We will expedite a vote in next week's plenary session to launch the special committee as quickly as possible." People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk also stated in a press conference at the National Assembly that "we must accelerate the pace of the investigation." (한병도 더불어민주당 원내대표는 9일 국회에서 열린 당 원내대책회의에서 “이번 사태는 대한민국 민주주의와 참정권 모두를 치명적으로 훼손한 참사”라며 “이번주에 즉각 본회의를 개최해 국정조사계획서를 보고하겠다. 다음주 본회의에서 곧장 의결해 최단시간 내에 특위를 가동하겠다”고 말했다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표도 국회 기자회견에서 국정조사의 “추진 속도를 높여야 한다”고 말했다.)

According to the requests for a National Assembly investigation submitted separately by the ruling and opposition parties the previous day, their positions differ on the scope of the probe and the composition of the special committee. Both parties agree on investigating the circumstances and current status of the ballot shortage crisis, but the People Power Party insists that the probe should also include "matters related to the police mobile unit's suppression of civilian violence during protest demonstrations." Additionally, the Democratic Party argues that the special committee should be formed according to the party's seat ratio in the National Assembly (10 members for the Democratic Party, 6 for the People Power Party, and 2 for non-negotiating groups), while the People Power Party maintains that it should be composed equally with 9 members from each side. The People Power Party also insists that a member of their party should chair the special committee. Typically, the chairmanship of special committees alternates between the ruling and opposition parties, but the chair of the previous "Manipulated Indictment Special Committee" was held by a Democratic Party lawmaker. (전날 여야가 각각 국회에 제출한 국정조사요구서를 보면, 조사 범위와 국조특위 구성 등에서 입장이 갈린다. 투표용지 부족 사태의 발생 경위와 현황 등에 대한 조사에는 여야 모두 찬성하지만, 국민의힘은 항의 시위 과정에서 불거진 ‘경찰 기동대의 시민 폭력 진압 사태에 관한 사항’도 조사 범위에 담아야 한다고 했다. 또 민주당은 국회 의석 비율대로 국조특위 위원 정수(민주당 10명, 국민의힘 6명, 비교섭단체 2명)를 꾸려야 한다고 했고, 국민의힘은 여야 9 대 9 동수로 해야 한다는 입장이다. 국민의힘은 국조특위 위원장도 소속 의원이 맡아야 한다는 방침이다. 통상 특위 위원장은 여야가 번갈아 맡는데, 직전 ‘조작 기소 국조특위’ 위원장을 민주당 의원이 맡았다는 이유다.)

Amidst this, Floor Leader Han responded to People Power Party lawmaker Kim Jae-seop's demand from the previous day to "include President Lee and the Blue House in the investigation target," saying, "Is this about fundamentally solving the problem, or using this incident as material for your own political gain?" He added, "Stop this irresponsible political manipulation." (이런 가운데 한 원내대표는 전날 김재섭 국민의힘 의원이 “국정조사 대상에 이재명 대통령과 청와대를 포함하라”고 요구한 데 대해 “근본적인 문제를 해결하자는 거냐, 아니면 이번 사태를 자신들의 정치적 이익을 위한 소재로 활용하자는 거냐”며 “무책임한 선동 정치를 그만두라”고 반발했다.)

Meanwhile, the Central Election Commission's "Truth-Finding Committee on the Ballot Shortage Crisis" announced on this day that it plans to conduct a ten-day investigation starting from the 10th into the overall ballot shortage crisis that occurred during the main voting process of the June 3 local elections, covering areas such as ballot printing, allocation, and supply management. (한편 중앙선거관리위원회 ‘투표지 부족 사태 진상규명위원회’는 10일부터 열흘간 투표용지 인쇄와 배정, 수급 관리 등 6·3 지방선거 본투표 과정에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태 전반을 조사할 계획이라고 이날 밝혔다.)

Reporters Kim Chae-woon and Jang Na-rae cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 장나래 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Controversy over Jang Dong-hyuk’s Overreach: “Is Calling for a By-election Saying Oh Se-hoon Should Step Down?” (장동혁 무리수 논란…“재선거, 오세훈 그만두라는 얘기냐?”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, reiterated the need to hold nationwide by-elections for the June 3 local elections on the 9th, arguing that “we should expedite the revision of election laws to allow for by-elections to be conducted without early voting.” Critics are mounting that he is making an overreach by even bringing up the abolition of early voting, while the directly affected party, Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, has already dismissed the idea of a by-election. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 9일 전국적인 6·3 지방선거 재선거 실시 필요성을 거듭 강조하면서 “재선거부터 사전투표 없이 실시할 수 있도록 선거법 개정 작업을 서둘러야 한다”고 주장했다. 당사자인 오세훈 서울시장도 재선거를 일축한 상황에서 사전투표 폐지론까지 끌어들이는 무리수를 두고 있다는 비판이 거세지고 있다.)

During a press conference at the National Assembly that day, Jang cited the ballot shortage incident, stating, “The fundamental solution to the deprivation of voting rights is a nationwide by-election,” and adding, “I will quickly proceed with internal party discussions to propose a special bill for holding nationwide by-elections.” (장 대표는 이날 국회 기자회견에서 투표용지 부족 사태를 언급하며 “참정권 박탈 사태의 근본 해결은 전국 재선거밖에 없다”며 “전국 재선거 실시를 위한 특별법을 발의할 수 있도록 신속하게 당내 논의를 진행하겠다”고 말했다.)

Jang further claimed, “In the Incheon mayoral election, the votes for candidate Yoo Jeong-bok and candidate Park Chan-dae were exactly identical in the early voting at Songdo 1-dong and Songdo 2-dong, which has a probability of 1 in 590 million,” and “In the South Jeolla-Gwangju integrated mayoral election, there were as many as 10 districts where the two candidates received the same number of votes—a probability that requires multiplying 1 in 590 million six times.” He then insisted, “We must extend the main voting days and definitely abolish early voting.” The Incheon and South Jeolla election commissions rebutted Jang’s claims, urging him to “refrain from raising baseless suspicions of election fraud simply because of probabilistically rare cases.” <<> Criticism also emerged from within the People Power Party itself, with some finding Jang’s arguments difficult to accept. <<> Mayor Oh Se-hoon immediately stated in an interview with the Chosun Ilbo published that day, “Unless a procedural flaw is a serious illegality that could alter the outcome, by-elections cannot be held.” Lawmaker Park Jeong-ha likewise said in an MBC radio interview, “What benefit would a by-election bring to our party? Isn’t that essentially telling Mayor Oh Se-hoon to step down?” Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok commented on the call to abolish early voting, saying, “As of today, the People Power Party has declared its unity with former President Yoon Suk-yeol, who, in a delusion, sent the military to the election commission, so it has become the ‘Yoon Again’ party.” <<> That day, calls for Jang to take responsibility for the election defeat continued. At a debate evaluating the local election results hosted by the party’s internal reform-oriented group “Alternatives and Future,” Lawmaker Kim Jae-seop stated, “Thanks to the tactic of ‘avoiding Chairman Jang,’ we won the Seoul mayoral election.” <<> By Jang Na-rae, staff reporter wing@hani.co.kr (장 대표는 이어 “인천광역시장 선거 송도1동과 송도2동 관내 사전투표에서 유정복 후보와 박찬대 후보의 득표수가 완전히 일치했는데 그럴 확률이 5억9천만분의 1”이라며 “전남광주통합시장 선거에선 두 후보의 득표수가 똑같은 지역이 무려 10곳이나 있었다. 이는 5억9천만분의 1을 6번 곱해야 하는 확률”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 장 대표는 “본투표 날짜 늘리고 사전투표는 반드시 없애야 한다”고 주장했다. 인천과 전남선관위는 장 대표의 주장에 대해 “확률적으로 드문 사례라는 이유만으로 근거 없는 부정선거 의혹을 제기하는 행위를 자제해달라”고 반박했다.)

item.title: PPP's new floor leader candidates show differing views on Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation, cautious on Han Dong-hoon's return (국힘 새 원내대표 후보들, 장동혁 사퇴 ‘온도차’·한동훈 복귀 ‘천천히’)
item.description:
On the 9th, lawmakers Kim Do-eup, Jung Jeom-sik, and Sung Il-jong (listed in alphabetical order by Korean initial consonant), running for the People Power Party (PPP) floor leader election, appealed for support by outlining plans for party reform to first- and second-term lawmakers. Kim Do-eup and Sung Il-jong, categorized as the "non-power faction," spoke of "change," while Jung Jeom-sik, seen as part of the "power faction," emphasized "party unity," showing differences in perspective. (국민의힘 원내대표 경선에 나선 김도읍·정점식·성일종(기호순) 의원이 9일 초·재선 의원을 상대로 당 쇄신 방향을 밝히며 지지를 호소했다. ‘비당권파’로 분류된 김도읍, 성일종 의원은 ‘변화’를 말했고, ‘당권파’로 꼽히는 정점식 의원은 ‘당내 결속’을 강조하며 시각차를 보였다.)

A day ahead of the floor leader election on the 10th, the three lawmakers attended a forum hosted by first- and second-term PPP lawmakers at the National Assembly, where they evaluated the June 3 local elections and outlined their visions for party reform. (세 의원은 원내대표 경선(10일)을 하루 앞둔 이날 국회에서 열린 국민의힘 초·재선 의원 주최 토론회에 참석해 6·3 지방선거를 평가하고 당 쇄신 방안에 대한 구상을 각각 밝혔다.)

Kim (four-term, Gangseo-gu, Busan), the first speaker, urged a shift in the party's direction, stating, "Continuing as we are is not right. Going this way, the 2028 general election and even the 2030 presidential election will be truly hopeless," and added, "Let's make it so we no longer hear the label of being a pro-Yoon (pro-Yoon Suk-yeol) party." (첫 주자로 나선 김 의원(4선·부산 강서)은 “지금 이 상태로 가는 것은 맞지 않는다. 이대로 가다가는 28년 총선, 나아가서 30년 대선은 정말 절망적”이라며 “도로 친윤(친윤석열)당이라는 소리는 더 이상 듣지 않는 당으로 만들자”고 당의 노선 변화를 외쳤다.)

Jung (three-term, Tongyeong-Goseong, South Gyeongsang) said, "Following the general and presidential elections, we have failed to gain majority support from the public even in the local elections. I feel a heavy sense of responsibility in the face of this painful reality." Yet he emphasized party unity, saying, "The conclusion of this intense deliberation over whether it should be (leadership) resignation or (internal) recovery must not lead to yet another division among ourselves." (정 의원(3선·경남 통영고성)은 “총선과 대선에 이어서 지방선거에서까지 국민 다수의 지지를 얻는 데 실패했다. 이 뼈아픈 현실 앞에서 참으로 무거운 책임감을 느낀다”면서도 “(지도부) 사퇴냐 (당내) 수습이냐를 두고 벌어지는 이 치열한 고뇌의 결론이 우리끼리의 또 다른 분열이 되어서는 안 된다”고 당내 결속에 방점을 찍었다.)

Sung (three-term, Taean-Seosan, South Chungcheong), who has less factional affiliation, stated, "Through the floor leader election, we must send a clear signal to the public that 'this party is changing.'" He added, "Now is not the time for factional fights between pro-Han (pro-Han Dong-hoon) and pro-Yoon groups." (계파색이 옅은 성 의원(3선·충남 태안서산)은 “원내대표 선거를 통해서 ‘아, 이 당이 변하고 있구나’ 하는 시그널을 국민에게 명확하게 보내야 한다”며 “지금 친한(친한동훈), 친윤 계파 싸움 할 때가 아니다”라고 했다.)

There were also differing views on the early resignation of leader Jang Dong-hyuk. In the closed-door forum, Kim reportedly said, "Many lawmakers agree on the need for Jang's resignation, but the method should not be too drastic." Sung was also quoted as saying, "It's clear he must take responsibility for the results, but forcing him out is not desirable." Unlike the two lawmakers who agreed on the necessity of Jang's resignation, Jung reportedly said, "We should analyze the reasons for the local election defeat and gather the opinions of lawmakers. It shouldn't appear as a party division. It should be handled quietly." However, all three lawmakers reportedly took a cautious stance regarding the reinstatement of independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon into the party. (장동혁 대표 조기 퇴진에 대한 입장도 온도차가 있었다. 비공개 토론회에서 김 의원은 “의원들 다 장 대표 사퇴에 공감한다. 방법이 과격하면 안 된다”고 했고, 성 의원도 “결과에 책임져야 한다는 건 확실하다. (다만) 억지로 쫓아내는 건 바람직하지 않다”고 한 것으로 알려졌다. 장 대표 사퇴 필요성에 공감한 두 의원과 달리 정 의원은 “지방선거 패배 원인을 분석하고 의원님들 중지를 모으겠다”며 “당의 분열로 비치면 안 된다. 조용하게 해야 한다”고 말한 것으로 전해졌다. 다만 한동훈 무소속 의원 복당과 관련해서는 세 의원 모두 서두르지 않겠다는 입장을 보였다고 한다.)

Within the party, Jung Jeom-sik, seen as an "original pro-Yoon," is considered highly likely to win. Observations suggest that the mainstream pro-Yoon faction and the power bloc will push Jung to maintain their leadership role. A second-term lawmaker told *The Hankyoreh*, "There is no discussion of accountability for the election defeat within the party, so it seems we'll end up with the power faction again." (당내에선 ‘원조 친윤’으로 꼽히는 정점식 의원이 당선 가능성이 크다고 보고 있다. 당내 주류인 친윤계와 당권파가 정 의원을 앞세워 주도권을 유지하려 할 것이라는 관측이 나온다. 한 재선 의원은 한겨레에 “당내에서 선거 패배의 책임론이 전혀 나오지 않는 상황이라, 또 당권파가 될 것 같다”고 말했다.)

Kim Hae-jung, reporter sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party in Turmoil Over Dissatisfaction with Presidential Election Results…Blame Shifts to Chung Cheong-rae (이 대통령 선거 결과 불만에 민주당 술렁…정청래 책임론 솔솔)
item.description:
Following President Lee Jae-myung's press conference marking his first year in office, where he indirectly raised the issue of the party leadership's responsibility for the June 3 local election results, the Democratic Party of Korea is in turmoil. Even at the airport send-off event for President Lee, who departed for a European tour on the 9th to attend the G7 summit, Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae was absent. (이재명 대통령이 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 6·3 지방선거 결과에 대한 당 지도부 책임론을 우회적으로 제기한 뒤 더불어민주당 내부가 술렁이고 있다. 9일 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 참석차 유럽 순방길에 오른 이 대통령의 공항 환송 행사에도 정청래 민주당 대표는 불참했다.)

Party leadership, including leader Chung and floor leader Han Byeong-do, did not see President Lee off as he boarded Air Force One at Seoul Air Base in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, on the morning of the 9th, heading to Brussels, Belgium, the first stop of his European tour. This marks the first time since Chung took office as party leader in August last year that he failed to see off President Lee on a tour. The presidential office explained, "Considering the prolonged Middle East war and the need to address poor management issues at the National Election Commission, we minimized the number of officials seeing him off, including those from the presidential office and the cabinet." In contrast, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who had previously attended events welcoming the president back, attended the send-off for the first time. A source from the prime minister's office said, "We received an invitation from the presidential office." <<> In a press conference marking his first year in office the previous day at the State Guesthouse, President Lee responded to a reporter's question about the local election results, saying, "If you lose where you should win, it's hardly a success. An incomprehensible situation has occurred," criticizing the Chung Cheong-rae leadership, which had described the local election results as a 'half victory.' The president further said of Prime Minister Kim, "With truly outstanding leadership, the cabinet has run fiercely toward a single goal without major noise or conflict, in the direction I have set. Now, it seems appropriate for you to take on a different role, so we are changing roles." This is interpreted as a message supporting Prime Minister Kim, who announced his resignation on the 7th to run for the party convention. <<> Voices within the party calling for Chung's accountability continued. Lawmaker Song Young-gil, meeting with reporters at the National Assembly on the same day, pointed out, "The president viewed the Pyeongtaek (B) by-election, expecting it would be a win, but was greatly disappointed, and there were some tendencies within our party's mainstream to almost tolerate the defeat of candidate Kim Yong-nam." Lawmaker Lee Geon-tae wrote on Facebook, "Despite the president's high approval ratings and a political environment favorable to the Democratic Party, the fact that we lost (in the Pyeongtaek B by-election) itself shows there were problems with the party's election strategy and leadership. The leadership should also bear responsibility for the loss." <<> It is known that on this day, Chung visited North Jeolla Province on an unofficial schedule, having lunch with Governor-elect Lee Won-taek and gauging local sentiments in the Honam region. Since the Honam party base, which comprises one-third of the party's dues-paying members, is essential for his reelection as party leader, there is a perception both inside and outside the party that this move is part of preparations for the party convention. Chung plans to hold a field supreme council meeting at the Kim Dae-jung Convention Center in Gwangju on the 12th and also visit the May 18 Democracy Cemetery. Chung is expected to resign from his leadership position and officially announce his candidacy for reelection around the time the party convention preparation committee is formed, likely next week. <<> Amid interpretations that President Lee expressed his 'true intentions' through the send-off, attention is also focused on how President Lee's 'message' will influence the upcoming party convention phase. Lawmaker Park Ji-won said on the YouTube channel 'Maebul Show,' "The Chung Cheong-rae leadership should take note. The party convention cannot proceed like this. It must be a quiet convention." There are also indications that it could backfire and become a political burden. A senior lawmaker told the Hankyoreh, "This is a golden time to focus on work since there are no elections for the next two years. If the president interferes with party leadership, he ends up at the center of political strife." <<> Reporter Koh Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (정 대표와 한병도 원내대표 등 당 지도부는 이날 오전 경기 성남시 서울공항에서 유럽 순방 첫 국가인 벨기에 브뤼셀로 출국하기 위해 공군 1호기에 탑승하는 이 대통령을 배웅하지 않았다. 정 대표가 지난해 8월 당대표로 취임한 뒤 이 대통령 순방길을 배웅하지 않은 것은 처음이다. 청와대는 “중동 전쟁의 장기화와 선거관리위원회 부실 관리 대응 등의 국내 상황을 염두에 둬 청와대 및 내각 인사 등 환송 인원을 최소화했다”고 설명했다. 반면 통상 대통령 귀국 행사에 참석해왔던 김민석 총리는 이날 처음 환송 행사에 참석했다. 총리실 관계자는 “청와대로부터 초청이 있었다”고 했다.)

item.title: North Korea and China Mention Military Cooperation for First Time in Seventh Summit…Denuclearization Sinks Below the Surface (북·중, 7번 회담중 군사협력 첫 언급…‘비핵화’는 수면밑 잠복)
item.description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping returned to Beijing on the 9th after concluding his first visit to North Korea in seven years. Through their summit meeting on the 8th, North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un and President Xi are assessed to have strategically elevated bilateral relations by strengthening cooperation in military and economic fields. Notably, North Korea avoided public discussion of denuclearization as desired, while China appears to have succeeded in curbing North Korea's alignment with Russia by enhancing North Korea-China military cooperation. (시진핑 중국 국가주석이 9일 7년 만의 방북을 마치고 베이징으로 돌아갔다. 김정은 북한 국무위원장과 시 주석은 지난 8일 정상회담을 통해 군사, 경제 분야 협력을 강화하며 양국 관계를 전략적으로 고도화한 것으로 평가된다. 특히 북한은 바람대로 비핵화 문제가 공개적으로 거론되는 것을 피했고, 중국은 북-중 군사 협력 강화를 통해 북-러 밀착을 견제하는 성과를 거둔 것으로 보인다.)

Since the North Korea-China summit on the 8th, no mention of North Korean denuclearization has appeared in Chinese Foreign Ministry statements or North Korean media up to this day. (지난 8일 북-중 정상회담 뒤 이날까지 중국 외교부 발표나 북한 매체에서 북한 비핵화 표현은 전혀 등장하지 않았다.)

Prior to Xi's visit, North Korea strongly hinted through the actions of Chairman Kim and Kim Yo-jong, head of the North Korean Workers' Party Central Committee, that denuclearization would not be on the summit agenda. (북한은 시 주석 방북 전부터 김 위원장과 김여정 북한 노동당 총무부장의 행보를 통해 비핵화는 회담 의제가 아니라는 점을 강력하게 암시했다.)

On the 7th, the day before Xi's visit, Kim Yo-jong dismissed the U.S. State Department's stance that Xi and U.S. President Donald Trump had agreed on North Korean denuclearization, calling it a "false rumor game." Chairman Kim also showcased his commitment to North Korea's status as a nuclear power by revealing a visit on the 3rd to a new nuclear material production facility, believed to be a uranium enrichment site. He emphasized that "thoroughly exercising the status of a nuclear weapons state is an invariable political and military stance we must uphold." The fact that denuclearization was not mentioned at all suggests that North Korea's position prevailed at the North Korea-China summit. Analysts interpret China's approach as refraining from raising denuclearization, which North Korea finds sensitive, especially given the need to curb North Korea's close ties with Russia—while competing fiercely with the U.S.—and to bolster China's strategic position on the Korean Peninsula. Lee Hee-ok, professor emeritus at Sungkyunkwan University, stated, "China appears to be managing the denuclearization issue without aggravating the situation," adding, "While promoting cooperation in areas like external investment and opening up economically, it's sinking sensitive issues below the surface." (김 부장은 시 주석 방북 전날인 7일 시 주석과 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 북한 비핵화 방침에 동의했다는 미국 국무부 입장을 “거짓 유포 놀음”이라며 일축했다. 김 위원장도 지난 3일 우라늄 농축 시설로 보이는 새 핵물질 생산공장을 시찰하는 모습을 공개하며 핵보유국 지위에 대한 의지를 과시했다. 김 위원장은 이날 “핵보유국 지위를 철저히 행사하는 것은 우리가 견지해야 할 불변한 정치·군사적 입장”이라고 강조했다. 북한 비핵화가 전혀 언급되지 않았다는 점에서 북한의 입장이 북-중 정상회담에서 관철된 것으로 볼 수 있는 대목이다. 미국과 치열하게 경쟁하면서도 러시아와 밀착하는 북한을 견제해 한반도 안에서 전략적 입지를 키워야 하는 상황에서 중국은 북한이 민감해하는 비핵화에 언급하지 않는 태도를 취한 것으로 풀이된다. 이희옥 성균관대 명예교수는 “중국은 비핵화에 대해선 상황을 악화시키지 않고 관리하려는 것으로 보인다”며 “외부 투자나 개방 등 경제 분야에서의 협력을 증진하면서 (예민한 현안을) 수면 아래로 가라앉히는 것”이라고 말했다.)

Chairman Kim also mentioned support for China's core interest—the Taiwan issue—stating that "North Korea will consistently uphold the One China principle." (김 위원장은 “조선(북한)은 변함없이 하나의 중국 원칙을 견지할 것”이라며 중국이 양보할 수 없는 핵심 이익으로 여기는 대만 문제에 대한 지지를 언급하기도 했다.)

The first mention of military cooperation also drew attention. Military exchanges appeared on the agenda for the first time since Xi and Kim held their seventh summit starting from March 2018. A Unification Ministry official said on this day, "This is the first time military exchange has been publicly mentioned in North Korea-China relations under the Kim Jong-un era," adding, "We will monitor related developments." (군사 협력이 처음 언급된 것도 눈길을 끄는 대목이다. 군사 부문 교류는 시 주석과 김 위원장이 2018년 3월부터 현재까지 7번째 정상회담을 한 이래 처음 나온 안건이다. 통일부 당국자는 이날 “(김정은 시대) 북-중 관계에서 공개적으로 군대 분야 교류를 언급한 것은 처음으로 파악된다”며 “관련 동향을 주시하겠다”고 말했다.)

This appears to be the result of converging interests for both North Korea and China. China needed to check North Korea, which has rapidly aligned with Russia by dispatching troops in the Ukraine war. North Korea, too, has no reason to decline stronger military cooperation with China. Hong Min, a senior researcher at the Korea Institute for National Unification, noted, "As North Korea's close ties with Russia could lead to military technology transfers or nuclear weapons advancement, increasing strategic instability in the region, China may have felt the need to grasp the situation through personnel exchanges with the North Korean military." (이는 북한과 중국 양쪽의 이익이 일치한 결과로 보인다. 중국은 우크라이나 전쟁에 군사를 파병하며 러시아와 급속도로 밀착한 북한을 견제할 필요가 있었다. 북한 역시 중국과의 군사 협력 강화는 마다할 것이 없는 부분이다. 홍민 통일연구원 선임연구위원은 “북-러 밀착으로 군사적 기술 이전이나 핵무기 고도화 등 향후 이 지역에 전략적 불안정성이 커질 수 있어, 중국이 이런 부분을 관리하기 위해 북한 군대와 인적 교류 등을 하며 그 실태를 파악할 필요를 느꼈을 수 있다”고 말했다.)

However, it remains unclear how North Korea and China will strengthen military cooperation based solely on the summit results. Kim Heung-kyu, director of the U.S.-China Policy Research Institute at Ajou University, predicted, "This cooperation is unlikely to escalate into a three-way solidarity or alliance among North Korea, China, and Russia," adding, "China won't go so far as military cooperation with North Korea by blatantly making South Korea an enemy." (다만 회담 결과만으로는 북·중이 향후 어떻게 군사 협력을 강화할지는 미지수다. 김흥규 아주대 미중정책연구소 소장은 “이번 협력이 북·중·러 3국 차원의 연대나 동맹은 아닐 것”이라며 “중국이 노골적으로 한국을 적으로 만드는 방식으로 북-중 군사 협력까지 나아가진 않을 것”이라고 전망했다.)

The commitment to expand North Korea-China economic cooperation is also seen as noteworthy. China's Xinhua News Agency reported on the 8th that the summit results included the full reopening of border crossings and the resumption of civil aviation routes and international passenger trains. Possibilities are being raised for the opening of the new Yalu River Bridge connecting North Korea's Sinuiju and China's Dandong—completed but unopened for 10 years—and the realization of the Tumen River development plan. (북-중 경제 협력 확대 약속 또한 눈여겨볼 대목으로 평가된다. 중국 신화통신은 8일 국경 통상구 전면 재개통, 민간 항공 노선 및 국제 여객 열차의 운행 재개 등이 양국 정상회담 결과라고 보도했다. 완공 뒤 10년간 개통되지 않은 북한 신의주-중국 단둥 간 신압록강대교 개통이나 두만강 개발 계획이 가시화될 가능성이 거론된다.)

Xi and Chairman Kim also appear to have exchanged information and views on the situation in Northeast Asia, including the U.S. role. (시 주석과 김 위원장은 회담에서 미국을 포함한 동북아 정세에 대한 정보와 의견도 주고받은 것으로 보인다.)

After holding a summit with President Yoon Suk-yeol in January, followed by U.S.-China and China-Russia summits in May and then the North Korea-China summit, Xi effectively demonstrated China's dominance in Northeast Asian diplomacy. North Korea, too, appears to have received messages from South Korea and the U.S. through Xi. (시 주석은 지난 1월 이재명 대통령과 한-중 정상회담을 한 데 이어 5월엔 미-중, 중-러 정상회담을 마친 뒤 북-중 정상회담까지 마무리하며 사실상 동북아 외교의 주도권을 중국이 쥐었음을 과시했다. 북한 역시 시 주석을 통해 한국과 미국의 메시지를 전달받은 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: Re-election or resignation... Can Jang Dong-hyuk, cornered at the cliff's edge, hold on? [Gongdeok Pocha] (재선거냐 사퇴냐… 벼랑 끝 장동혁, 버틸 수 있을까? [공덕포차])
item.description:
The power structure within the People Power Party is in turmoil one day before the election for the floor leader. Beyond being a simple selection of the parliamentary command post, it is interpreted as a 'vote of confidence in Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk's system,' and the direction of the leadership may diverge depending on the outcome. (국민의힘 원내대표 선거를 하루 앞두고 당내 권력 구도가 요동치고 있습니다. 단순한 원내 사령탑 선출을 넘어 ‘장동혁 대표 체제에 대한 신임투표’ 성격으로 해석되며, 결과에 따라 지도부 향방이 갈릴 전망입니다.)

Three lawmakers—Kim Do-eup, Jeong Jeom-sik, and Seong Il-jong—have entered the race for the election on the 10th. If pro-leadership lawmaker Jeong Jeom-sik wins, it will strengthen the current leadership's position. However, if non-leadership lawmakers Kim Do-eup or Seong Il-jong win, the blame for the local election defeat is expected to spread, intensifying pressure on Chairman Jang's position. In particular, with former Chairman Han Dong-hoon elected as an independent in the by-election, the votes of the pro-Han faction have emerged as a key variable. <<> Meanwhile, the 'ballot shortage incident' has become a central political issue. The Democratic Party is pushing for a parliamentary investigation, while the People Power Party advocates for a special counsel and re-election. However, amid observations that a full re-election is not easy under current law, there are analyses that the nature of the political battle is becoming more pronounced. (10일 선거에는 김도읍, 정점식, 성일종 의원 등 세 명이 출마했습니다. 당권파인 정점식 의원이 당선될 경우 현 지도부 유지에 힘이 실리지만, 비당권파인 김도읍·성일종 의원이 승리할 경우 지방선거 패배 책임론이 확산되며 장 대표 거취 압박이 거세질 것으로 보입니다. 특히 한동훈 전 대표가 보궐선거에서 무소속으로 당선되면서, 친한계 의원들의 표심이 핵심 변수로 떠오르고 있습니다성도 제기됩니다.)

The ballot shortage at 91 polling stations nationwide has escalated into a controversy over the infringement of voting rights, with notably sensitive reactions from the youth. As President Lee Jae-myung stated, "I regret the lack of sensitivity to sovereignty," the youth's high standards for fairness and procedure are seen as factors that amplified this issue. (한편 ‘투표용지 부족 사태’는 정국 핵심 쟁점으로 떠올랐습니다. 민주당은 국정조사를, 국민의힘은 특검과 재선거를 주장하며 맞서고 있습니다. 다만 현행법상 전면 재선거는 쉽지 않다는 지적 속에 정치적 공방 성격이 짙다는 분석이 나옵니다.)

Can Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk, facing pressure to resign, hold on solely by advocating for a re-election? Why are young people showing such high interest in the ballot shortage incident? Can Han Seong-sook, the prime ministerial nominee under scrutiny with the controversy over owning multiple homes, pass the National Assembly confirmation hearing unscathed? We explore these questions on 'Gongdeok Pocha.' Check out the video! (전국 91개 투표소에서 발생한 용지 부족 사태는 참정권 침해 논란으로 번졌고, 특히 청년층의 민감한 반응이 두드러졌습니다. 이재명 대통령이 “주권 감수성 부족을 반성한다”고 밝힌 가운데, 공정성과 절차에 대한 청년층의 높은 기준이 이번 이슈를 키운 배경으로 평가됩니다.)

item.title: President Lee Arrives in Brussels, Begins ‘9-Night, 10-Day’ Schedule… Eyes on Meeting with Trump (이 대통령, 브뤼셀 도착 ‘9박10일’ 일정 시작…트럼프와 회동 촉각)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung departed on Monday for his first European tour since taking office, to attend the Group of Seven (G7) summit among other events. Attention is focused on whether a meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump will take place during the G7 summit. (이재명 대통령이 9일 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 참석 등을 위해 취임 뒤 첫 유럽 순방길에 올랐다. 7개국 정상회의 기간 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과의 회동이 이뤄질지 관심이 쏠린다.)

President Lee arrived in Brussels, Belgium, on Monday, embarking on a 9-night, 10-day European tour. Before departing from Seongnam Seoul Airport, he wrote on X (formerly Twitter): “I am visiting Europe for the first time since my inauguration. This is a journey to broaden the horizons of cooperation amid the global complex crisis and to further solidify the foundations of our economy and diplomacy.” <<> On Tuesday (local time), President Lee is scheduled to hold a summit with Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever and meet with King Philippe. He also plans to hold summits with European Council President António Costa and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen. From Wednesday to Friday, he will make a state visit to Italy. This marks his first state visit to a European country since taking office. President Lee is set to hold summits with Italian President Sergio Mattarella and Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni. <<> On Saturday and Sunday, he is expected to attend a special Mass for peace and solidarity at St. Paul’s Basilica in the Vatican, followed by a meeting with Pope Leo XIV. During a meeting with Cardinal Lazarus You Heung-sik, Prefect of the Dicastery for the Clergy, in July last year, President Lee said: “We are working to open the door for dialogue through improving inter-Korean relations, easing tensions, and building trust. We expect the support and cooperation of the Holy See.” <<> On Monday and Tuesday, President Lee will attend the G7 summit in Évian-les-Bains, France. Since President Trump is also expected to attend the summit, an informal South Korea-U.S. summit could take place. <<> Brussels/Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 벨기에 브뤼셀에 도착해 9박10일간의 유럽 순방 일정에 들어갔다. 이 대통령은 성남 서울공항 출국 전 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “취임 이후 처음으로 유럽을 방문한다. 글로벌 복합위기 속에서 협력의 지평을 넓히며, 우리 경제와 외교의 기반을 더욱 굳건히 다지기 위한 여정”이라고 썼다.)

item.title: President Lee: "If the rural basic income were permanently introduced, the effect would be much greater, wouldn't it?" (이 대통령 “농어촌 기본소득 영구도입하면 훨씬 효과 크겠죠”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, visiting Belgium, said on the 9th (local time) regarding the rural basic income pilot project, "If it were introduced permanently and the amount were increased, wouldn't the effect be much greater?" (벨기에를 방문한 이재명 대통령이 9일(현지시각) 농어촌 기본소득 시범사업과 관련해 “이를 영구적으로 도입하고 금액을 상향하면 훨씬 효과가 크겠지요?”라고 말했다.)

President Lee shared a Hankyoreh article on X (formerly Twitter) that day, which stated that the population of Okcheon County in North Chungcheong Province, which faced a demographic crisis, is rapidly recovering due to the implementation of the rural basic income pilot project. He then remarked, "Even though the rural basic income was introduced as a temporary two-year measure, this is the level of effect." The rural basic income pilot project provides local love gift certificates worth 150,000 won per month over two years (2026–2027) to residents of counties experiencing population decline. (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 ‘농어촌 기본소득 시범사업이 시행되면서 인구 소멸 위기를 맞았던 충북 옥천군의 인구가 빠르게 회복하고 있다’는 내용의 한겨레 기사를 공유했다. 그러면서 이 대통령은 “농어촌 기본소득 2년 한시 도입인데도 이 정도 효과”라고 말했다. 농어촌 기본소득 시범사업은 인구감소지역 군 주민을 대상으로 2026~2027년 2년간 월 15만원 상당의 지역사랑상품권을 지급하는 사업이다.)

President Lee also addressed the issue of funding, emphasizing that it ultimately comes down to "a matter of decision." He said, "Considering that the current budget per person in county-level areas typically exceeds 20 million won, it's clear that this is a matter of will and policy decisions, or in other words, a matter of budget priorities." He added, "Especially with the recent stock market boom, the special tax for rural areas, which must be used for rural regions, has surged into the trillions of won. If we use this budget not as before for securing infrastructure like farm roads and bridges, but as funding for the rural basic income, making it a permanent program and increasing the basic income amount from 150,000 won to more, then rural areas will also revive." (이 대통령은 재원 문제도 언급하며 결국 ‘결단의 문제’라고 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “군 단위 현재 예산은 보통 1인당 2천만원이 넘는다는 점을 고려하면 결국 의지와 정책 결단의 문제, 즉 예산의 우선순위 문제임을 알 수 있다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “특히 최근 주식시장 활성화로 농어촌에 의무적으로 사용해야 하는 농어촌특별세가 수조원대로 폭증하고 있는데, 이 예산을 종전대로 농로, 교량 등 기반시설 확보에 쓰지 않고 농어촌 기본소득 재원으로 활용해서 농어촌 기본소득을 지속사업으로 확정하고 기본소득액을 15만원에서 그 이상으로 높이면 농어촌도 살아난다”고 덧붙였다.)

President Lee stated, "This would increase the number of people returning to farming and fishing, prevent regional extinction, achieve balanced national land development, alleviate issues like skyrocketing housing prices due to concentration in the metropolitan area, and ensure a happy old age—it seems like it would have a multi-pronged effect. I'd like to hear your opinions as well." (이 대통령은 “(그러면) 귀농·귀어도 늘어나고, 지역소멸도 막고, 국토균형발전도 이루고, 수도권 집중에 따른 집값 폭등 같은 문제도 완화하고, 행복한 노년도 보장하는 등 일석다조 효과가 있을 것 같다”며 “여러분의 의견도 듣고 싶다”고 말했다.)

Brussels/Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (브뤼셀/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Meets Overseas Koreans in Belgium: “You Must Have Been Worried About the Rapidly Changing South Korea, Right?” (이 대통령, 벨기에 동포 만나 “격변하는 대한민국, 걱정 많이 했죠?”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said at a dinner meeting with overseas Koreans in Belgium on the 9th (local time), “You must have been worried seeing the rapidly changing South Korea, right?” and added, “We are recovering quickly. We will show you a South Korea that is much better than before.” <<> During the dinner held at a hotel in Belgium with local Korean residents, President Lee stated, “When you go abroad, don’t you usually become more patriotic? You develop more interest in domestic issues, and since you’re inevitably compared to others, the treatment you receive depends on your home country’s status or the level of trust it garners worldwide. You’ve probably felt this dramatically over the past two or three years.” This remark appears to indirectly reference former President Yoon Seok-yeol’s December 3 emergency martial law incident. <<> The president also emphasized the role of overseas diplomatic missions. He said, “So far, overseas diplomatic missions have been busy handling official government tasks, which is natural, but I think they need to go beyond that and serve as a platform for cultural industry expansion and for overseas Koreans.” <<> President Lee then added, “In terms of South Korea, you might be upset if I downgrade our ambassadors, but I think they are similar to the heads of community service centers. Depending on the scale, they could have a higher title, but ultimately, isn’t it about listening to the opinions of overseas compatriots and Koreans, resolving their inconveniences, and realizing South Korea’s national identity or status in a foreign country?” <<> Furthermore, in his concluding remarks, President Lee said, “I understand that in the Belgian overseas Korean community, the proportion of adopted Koreans is overwhelmingly high. Please make sure that we are not lacking in helping adopted Koreans find their past connections,” instructing the head of the Overseas Koreans Agency, according to Senior Press Secretary Kang Yu-jeong in a written briefing. <<> Brussels/Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 9일(현지시각) 벨기에 동포 만찬간담회에서 “격변하는 대한민국을 보면서 걱정 많이 했죠?”라며 “빠른 시간 내 또 회복하고 있다. 앞으로 지금까지와는 훨씬 더 나은 대한민국을 보여드릴 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: "Now you can say it's 50-50" – Daegu Surprised by Kim Boo-kyum's Defeat (“이젠 반반이라 보면 되지예” 대구도 놀란 김부겸의 패배)
item.description:
"Now you can say it's 50-50. People in Daegu have really changed a lot." (Lee, a 60-something shopkeeper running a dried fish store at Chilseong Market in Buk-gu, Daegu) (“이제는 반반이라고 보면 되지예. 대구 사람들이 참 많이 바뀌었어예.”(대구 북구 칠성시장에서 건어물 가게를 운영하는 60대 이아무개씨))

In the June 3 local elections for Daegu mayor, former Prime Minister Kim Boo-kyum, running as the Democratic Party candidate, suffered a "heated" defeat. Kim, who had been leading early in the race, garnered 45.1% of the vote, losing to Daegu Mayor-elect Choo Kyung-ho (53.9%) by 8.8 percentage points. On the 9th, citizens met in Daegu expressed a mix of emotions: hope seeing "the possibility of change," despair that "Daegu just can't change," and relief that "the heart of conservatism can't be handed over." <<> Regardless of the election outcome, citizens expressed surprise at Kim's "report card." Kim's vote share was the highest ever for a Democratic Party mayoral candidate in Daegu. He received 586,927 votes in this election—double President Lee Jae-myung's Daegu vote share in last year's presidential election (23.2%) and nearly three times the Democratic Party candidate's share (17.8%) in the 2022 local elections. Kim Boo-kyum's personal appeal seemed to boost voter turnout. A woman in her 70s said, "If Kim Boo-kyum had gone with the People Power Party, he would've been presidential material." A 60-something dried fish merchant added, "If Park Geun-hye hadn't run, it would've been 99.9% Kim Boo-kyum. But because of Park Geun-hye, everyone voted for Choo Kyung-ho." <<> Citizen reactions were relatively clear by generation. Yoo Jeom-soon (75) said, "Even if I want to vote for Kim Boo-kyum, when I step into the polling booth, I end up marking number 2. This place won't easily give it away. Who gives up their heart?" Han (80) also said, "Young people might go for Kim Boo-kyum, but us older folks, no matter what, stick with 'our side.' Naturally, it was Choo Kyung-ho." The overwhelming organizational power of the People Power Party was also evident. Kim (82) said, "We don't really know Kim Boo-kyum or Choo Kyung-ho well. Our district office chief came to the singing class and even sang two songs before leaving." <<> Kim's slogan of being a strong ruling party candidate seemed offset by distrust of the Democratic Party. Han Yang-ok (82) said, "No matter how much the Democratic Party takes over, without the nation's funds, they can't act as they please." A bean sprout shop owner expressed opposition to the "fabricated indictment" special counsel bill proposed by the Democratic Party, saying, "Those guys hold the knife handle and do as they please. Lee Jae-myung is trying to clear his own sins." A 70-something Lee said, "Saying they'll support you if Kim Boo-kyum wins and not if he doesn't—that's a bit sneaky. I think support should come regardless of who wins." <<> However, citizens under 50 did not hide their despair over Kim's defeat. Moon (50s), a resident of Manchon-dong, Daegu, said, "It was sad." Moon added, "It's hard for someone like Kim Boo-kyum to emerge in Daegu again. A national figure like Kim Boo-kyum invested 15 years in Daegu, yet still lost by 8 points. Daegu missed its last chance for change." Park (40s) said, "Daegu is always branded as 'conservative' or 'red party.' I even worried if our children, growing up, would be stigmatized for being from Daegu." She added, "I voted hoping things would change this time." Kim Young-jae (57), a self-employed voter who picked Kim Boo-kyum for mayor but the People Power Party for district office chief, said, "About that 'judgment on Yoon Suk-yeol' thing—I agree with it. Choo Kyung-ho isn't right. The People Power Party needs to wake up this time." <<> The generational voting gap was also evident in exit polls jointly conducted by three broadcasters (KBS, MBC, SBS). Kim's predicted vote share was 50.7% among those in their 30s, 66.3% among those in their 40s, and 57.3% among those in their 50s—ahead of Choo. However, Choo led overwhelmingly among those in their 60s (69.6%) and those 70 and older (81.4%). <<> Citizens who hoped for "change" also saw hope in Kim's failure. Kim (36) said, "Given Daegu, this is a strong performance. Honestly, many young people voted not because they liked Kim Boo-kyum, but because they're dead set against the People Power Party. As generations pass, Daegu seems likely to change." Lee Soo-yeon (32) said, "Many around me supported Kim Boo-kyum, so the results were disheartening," but added, "Maybe a better candidate will emerge next time. The outcome could differ depending on who runs." In these local elections, the Democratic Party secured 2 proportional representation seats for metropolitan councilors and 48 for base-level councilors in Daegu. item.title: President Lee on the 39th Anniversary of the June 10 Democratic Uprising: "The Power that Preserved Democracy Comes from the People" (이 대통령, 6·10 민주항쟁 39돌 맞아 “민주주의 지킨 힘 국민으로부터 나와”)
item.description:
<<>> President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 39th anniversary of the June 10 Democratic Uprising, "Looking back at history, the power that achieved national independence, as well as the power that built and preserved democracy, all came from the people." ()

In a Facebook post on the 10th, President Lee said, "Today marks the 39th anniversary of the June 10 Democratic Uprising and the 100th anniversary of the June 10 Independence Movement." He added, "Though the two events occurred 61 years apart, they share a commonality: they were days when 'popular sovereignty' was clearly manifested." ( 이재명 대통령이 6·10 민주항쟁 39돌을 맞아 “역사를 돌이켜보면, 나라의 독립을 이뤄낸 힘도, 민주주의를 만들고 지켜온 힘도 모두 국민으로부터 나왔다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the June 10 Independence Movement, President Lee described it as "an independence movement where our people united as one, transcending ideology, religion, and generations." On the June 10 Democratic Uprising, he said, "Citizens who stood against the military dictatorship demanded with one voice direct presidential elections through constitutional amendment and the realization of democracy. With that power, South Korea was able to end military dictatorship and reach a turning point toward democracy." He added, "On December 3, 2024, our people once again defended democracy with their bare hands, proving the worth and value of sovereignty themselves." ( 이 대통령은 10일 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “오늘은 6·10 민주항쟁 39주년이자, 6·10 만세운동이 일어난 지 100년이 되는 날”이라며 이렇게 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 “61년의 시간 차이를 두고 일어난 두 사건은 서로 다른 역사처럼 보이지만 ‘국민주권’이 분명하게 발현된 날이라는 공통점을 지니고 있다”고 했다.)

President Lee stated, "The popular sovereignty government will continue to faithfully uphold the will of the people, the true masters of the Republic of Korea, and further develop democracy." He also said, "Additionally, I promise to improve the people's lives, protect their safety, and move toward a peaceful and prosperous future." ( 이 대통령은 6·10 만세운동에 대해 “우리 민족이 이념과 종교, 세대를 넘어 하나로 뭉친 독립운동이었다”고 말했다. 6·10 민주항쟁을 두고는 “군부 독재에 맞선 시민들은 한목소리로 대통령 직선제 개헌과 민주주의 실현을 요구했고 그 힘으로 대한민국은 군부 독재를 종식하고 민주주의로 나아가는 전환점을 맞이할 수 있었다”고 했다. 그러면서 “2024년 12월3일 우리 국민은 다시금 맨손으로 민주주의를 지켜내며 주권의 의와 가치를 스스로 증명해 보였다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr ( 이 대통령은 “국민주권정부는 앞으로도 대한민국의 진정한 주인인 국민의 뜻을 충실히 받들며, 민주주의를 더욱 발전시켜 가겠다”며 “아울러 국민의 삶을 개선하고, 국민의 안전을 지키며, 평화롭고 번영하는 미래로 나아갈 것을 약속드린다”고 말했다.)

item.title: [Photo] President Lee's First Schedule on European Tour: "Meeting with Compatriots" ([포토] 이 대통령, 유럽 순방 첫 일정은 ‘동포 간담회’)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, who is visiting Europe on the occasion of the G7 Summit, met with Korean residents in Belgium on the 9th (local time) as his first schedule of this tour. (G7 정상회의 참석을 계기로 유럽을 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 9일(현지시각) 이번 순방의 첫 일정으로 벨기에 교민들과 만났다.)

At a dinner meeting held at a hotel in Brussels, Belgium, that day, President Lee emphasized that South Korea is recovering quickly despite the rapidly changing domestic situation and said, "From now on, we will show a better South Korea, different from what has been seen before." (이날 벨기에 브뤼셀의 한 호텔에서 열린 현지 교민과의 만찬간담회에서 이 대통령은 격변하는 국내 정세 속에서도 대한민국이 빠른 시간 내에 회복하고 있음을 강조하며, “앞으로는 지금까지와는 다른, 더 나은 대한민국을 보여드릴 것”이라고 말했다.)

He then stressed the need for a change in the role of overseas missions, explaining that they should go beyond simple official government work to support the advancement of the cultural industry and serve as a platform for overseas compatriots. In particular, he compared the role of an ambassador to that of a neighborhood chief of a community center, adding that it is important to listen to the opinions of local compatriots and address their inconveniences. (이어 재외공관의 역할 변화를 강조하며, 단순한 정부 공식 업무 처리를 넘어 문화산업 진출을 지원하고 재외교민들의 플랫폼 역할을 수행해야 한다고 설명했다. 특히 대사의 역할을 주민자치센터의 동장에 비유하며, 현지에서 교민들의 의견을 청취하고 불편을 해소하는 것이 중요하다고 덧붙였다.)

Meanwhile, Senior Press Secretary Kang Yoo-jung said in a written briefing that President Lee, considering the characteristics of the Belgian Korean community, requested the head of the Overseas Koreans Agency to "take good care so that adopted compatriots face no shortcomings in finding their past connections." We have compiled photos from President Lee Jae-myung's arrival in Belgium and the meeting with local compatriots. (한편, 강유정 수석대변인은 서면브리핑을 통해 이 대통령이 벨기에 동포사회의 특성을 고려해 “입양동포들이 과거 인연을 찾는 데 부족함이 없도록 잘 챙겨보라”고 재외동포청장에게 당부했다고 전했다. 이재명 대통령의 벨기에 도착과 현지 교민과의 간담회 현장 사진을 모아본다.)
